context.transcript:
Olivier, thank you for volunteering to organize our quarterly managers meeting.
I appreciate you taking time out of your regular work schedule to do this.
Speaking of which, any updates on the lunch plans?
Well, I just heard from the restaurant we went to last quarter.
Unfortunately, they're fully booked that day.
Too bad.
I was hoping they'd be available.
Well, an Italian restaurant just opened nearby.
I'll look into it.
Also, I just received an email from the print shop.
They're waiting for the presentation schedule to add to the program.
I'll send them an updated version shortly.
context.transcript_translation:
Olivier，感谢你自愿组织我们的季度经理会议。
我很感激你抽出宝贵时间来做这件事。
说起这个，午餐计划有什么更新吗？
嗯，我刚从我们上个季度去的餐厅那里听到消息。
不幸的是，那天他们已经订满了。
太可惜了。
我本来希望他们能有空。
嗯，附近新开了一家意大利餐厅。
我会去了解一下的。
另外，我刚刚收到印刷店的一封邮件。
他们在等演示日程表来添加到节目册上。
我很快会给他们发送一个更新的版本。
